texts.en:
Our Psionic Aura now has the ability to gain Intensity and spread into other systems.

Psionic Auras can reach three thresholds of Intensity, with scaling effects. If a Psionic Aura reaches a new level of Intensity, or maximizes its Intensity, it will attempt to spread to adjacent systems. Most Psionic Auras have a maximum range they can spread from their source.

Aura Intensity can be increased through various means, such as high Psionic populations, £happiness£ Happiness levels, £job_telepath£ [GetTelepathCap] Jobs, and Psychic Governors or £leader£ Leaders of £sector£ Sectors.
